title: IRT/RTSM UAT tracker
summary: A user acceptance testing tracker for a synthetic interactive response technology (IRT/RTSM) build: 29 test scripts traced to requirements, a defect log, and a go-live sign-off gate that recomputes as you mark tests and close defects. The gate packages the evidence for a named tester or biostatistician to sign; it does not grant approval. Operations data only, with no participant data.
try: Click a row in the test-script table, then mark the test Pass, Fail or Blocked in the sidebar: the counts and the area plot update.
In the defect log, double-click a Status cell, change Open to Closed and press Enter: the gate's checklist moves.
Close both open critical or major defects: the gate stays blocked until every critical test passes and every requirement has a test.
Download the test results as a CSV built in your browser, or Reset to seed to start over.
